tags.name: Uncommon
tags.effect: The next shop will have a free Uncommon Joker .
tags.notes:
The Joker is extra generated, and guaranteed to appear in next shop, which is not affected by Vouchers that relatively lower the weight of Jokers in Shop (see The Shop#Vouchers ), or certain Challenges that Jokers' spawn rate is set to 0.
Can be stacked with Edition Tags, generating a free Joker with Editions .

tags.name: Rare
tags.effect: The next shop will have a free Rare Joker .

tags.name: Negative
tags.effect: The next base edition Joker you find in a Shop becomes Negative (+1 joker slot) and free.
tags.notes:
If there are no base edition Jokers in the next shop, these tags will instead be stored. Works with Uncommon and Rare Tag if the generated Joker doesn't have an Edition naturally.
Can be stacked on one shop until there are no base edition Jokers.

tags.name: Foil
tags.effect: The next base edition Joker you find in a Shop becomes Foil ( +50 Chips ) and free.

tags.name: Holographic
tags.effect: The next base edition Joker you find in a Shop becomes Holographic ( +10 Mult ) and free.

tags.name: Polychrome
tags.effect: The next base edition Joker you find in a Shop becomes Polychrome ( X1.5 Mult ) and free.

tags.name: Investment
tags.effect: Gain $25 after defeating the next Boss Blind .
tags.notes: Can be stacked on one Boss Blind, each adding additional $25 bonus.

tags.name: Voucher
tags.effect: Adds a Voucher to the next Shop.
tags.notes: Can be stacked on one shop until all available vouchers appear (excluding bought vouchers and upgrades of unbought vouchers). Added vouchers do not carry over to later shops in the ante.

tags.name: Boss
tags.effect: Re-rolls the next Boss Blind .
tags.notes: If the Director's Cut has been redeemed, using the Boss tag to re-roll the next Boss Blind will also use up the one Re-Roll option.

tags.name: Standard
tags.effect: Immediately open a free Mega Standard Pack .
tags.notes: Other effects of opening Booster Packs (like Red Card and Hallucination ) can be activated as normal.

tags.name: Charm
tags.effect: Immediately open a free Mega Arcana Pack .

tags.name: Meteor
tags.effect: Immediately open a free Mega Celestial Pack .

tags.name: Buffoon
tags.effect: Immediately open a free Mega Buffoon Pack .

tags.name: Handy
tags.effect: Gain $1 for each hand played this run.

tags.name: Garbage
tags.effect: Gain $1 for each unused discard this run.

tags.name: Ethereal
tags.effect: Immediately open a free Spectral Pack .
tags.notes: It is the only one among Pack-related Tags that does not give a Mega pack. Other effects of opening Booster Packs (like Red Card and Hallucination ) can be activated as normal.

tags.name: Coupon
tags.effect: In the next shop, initial Jokers , Consumables Cards and Booster Packs are free ($0).
tags.notes: Other parts of the shop (such as Vouchers and Items generated after rerolls) keep their usual costs.

tags.name: Double
tags.effect: Gives a copy of the next Tag selected (excluding Double Tags).
tags.notes: Can be stacked on one Tag earned, each adding one additional copy of (instead of doubling) that Tag.

tags.name: Juggle
tags.effect: +3 Hand Size for the next round only.
tags.notes: Can be stacked multiple times on the same round, each adding an additional +3 Hand size.

tags.name: D6
tags.effect: In the next Shop , Rerolls start at $0 .
tags.notes: The price will go up $1 per Reroll as normal.

tags.name: Top-up
tags.effect: Create up to 2 Common Jokers (if you have space).
tags.notes: The Jokers created cannot have Stickers , like Eternal/Perishable/Rental, even at higher stakes.

tags.name: Speed
tags.effect: Gives $5 for each Blind you've skipped this run.
tags.notes: Guaranteed to give at least $5 , as it includes the Blind skipped to gain this tag.

tags.name: Orbital
tags.effect: Upgrades a specified random Poker Hand by three levels.
tags.notes: The hand can be a secret hand if it has already been played in this run.

tags.name: Economy
tags.effect: Doubles your money (adds a maximum of $40 ) .
tags.notes: If your balance is negative your money is not doubled, instead giving you $0 and essentially wasting the tag.

spectrals.name: Familiar

spectrals.name: Wraith

spectrals.name: Sigil

spectrals.name: Ouija

spectrals.name: Ectoplasm

spectrals.name: Immolate
spectrals.effect: Destroys 5 random cards in hand, but gain $20 .

spectrals.name: Ankh
spectrals.effect: Creates a copy of 1 of your Jokers at random, then destroys the others, leaving you with two identical Jokers. ( Editions are also copied, except Negative)

spectrals.name: Deja Vu
spectrals.effect: Adds a Red Seal to 1 selected card.

spectrals.name: Hex
spectrals.effect: Adds Polychrome to a random Joker , and destroys the rest.

spectrals.name: Trance
spectrals.effect: Adds a Blue Seal to 1 selected card.

spectrals.name: Medium
spectrals.effect: Adds a Purple Seal to 1 selected card.

spectrals.name: Cryptid
spectrals.effect: Creates 2 exact copies (including Enhancements, Editions and Seals ) of a selected card in your hand.

spectrals.name: The Soul
spectrals.effect: Creates a Legendary Joker. (Must have room) Artwork: This card is animated, with the gem beating like a heart, or perhaps something inside is trying to break out...

spectrals.name: Black Hole
spectrals.effect: Upgrades every poker hand (including secret hands not yet discovered) by one level.
